# Increasing Decreasing String.

@example Up: a, b, n. Down: n, a. Up: the last a.
"banana"
=> "abnnaa"

@example Up: x, y, z. Down: z again (its second copy, taken right at the turn), then y.
"zyzxy"
=> "xyzzy"

@example The letters are all different, so the first upward pass takes every one, in alphabetical order.
"zebra"
=> "aberz"

# A single letter.
"q"
=> "q"

# Two copies of one letter: the downward pass takes the second right after
# the upward pass took the first.
"kk"
=> "kk"

# One letter only: every pass takes a single copy.
"ppppppp"
=> "ppppppp"

# All 26 letters, from z down: one upward pass sorts them.
"zyxwvutsrqponmlkjihgfedcba"
=> "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

# Two letters, two of each: up a, b; down b, a.
"baba"
=> "abba"

# The turn at the bottom: the downward pass ends on a, and the next upward
# pass starts with a again.
"baaa"
=> "abaa"

# Four a's, four z's and one m: up a, m, z; down z, a; up a, z; down z, a.
"zzaazmzaa"
=> "amzzaazza"

# Uneven counts (i 4, m 1, p 2, s 4): the letters run out at different
# passes, so later passes skip over gaps.
"mississippi"
=> "impsspiissi"

# Only m is left for the last four passes.
"mmbmmam"
=> "abmmmmm"

# 258 copies of e with one a and two z's: a count kept in a byte would
# wrap around.
"zeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeaeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeez"
=> "aezzeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee"

# The longest input: one letter 500 times.
""
=> ""

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"bddbhhhhb"
=> "bdhhdbbhh"

@gen 2 small
"yzzxxxy"
=> "xyzzyxx"

@gen 3 small
"aaazzz"
=> "azzaaz"

@gen 4 small
"zaaz"
=> "azza"

@gen 5 small
"bbaabaabac"
=> "abcbaabbaa"

@gen 6 small
"bb"
=> "bb"

@gen 7 small
"hd"
=> "dh"

# Full size: 500 letters (shape picked by the seed).
@gen 1
""
=> ""

@gen 2
""
=> ""

@gen 5
""
=> ""
